data_lineage.null_bank_generation: build_bank('null') with NULL_KERNEL (same for both regimes), R from (cur_state, action) only, noise_rate=0.40
data_lineage.positive_bank_generation: build_bank('positive') with POS_KERNEL_A/B (different per regime), regime switches every 10 steps, R from stochastic mixing (regime primary), noise_rate=0.30
data_lineage.iid_null_bank_generation: Resampled S_next from positive bank marginal P(S_next)
data_lineage.k_alpha_fitting: K = n_states_observed per stratum on TRAIN, alpha = 1/K
data_lineage.entropy_estimation: Exact Dirichlet-Multinomial plug-in with shared K,alpha per stratum
data_lineage.permutation_test: 1000 trajectory-grouped shuffles within C strata, seed 42
data_lineage.bonferroni: Effective n_tests from pairwise BC correlation < 0.95 (result: 1)

validity_checks_performed: G0: Analytic centering |perm_mean - analytic_mean| < 0.03 and |analytic_mean| < 0.1 — FAILED
G1: Null bank p_bonf > 0.10 and |BC| < 0.05 — PASSED
G2: Positive bank p_bonf < 0.01 and BC > 0.05 and gap >= 0.05 — FAILED
Non-negative CMI: H(S_next|C) >= H(S_next|C,R) by construction (shared K,alpha) — VERIFIED
TRAIN/TEST separation: All fitting on TRAIN only, metrics on TEST — VERIFIED
Deterministic reproduction: Re-run with same seeds yields identical results — VERIFIED
known_limitations: Analytic null bias: With ~440 strata and ~2.5 samples/stratum, E[PMI] formula yields 3-5 bits instead of ~0. This is a fundamental property of the digamma formula at small N_c, not a bug.
Estimator sensitivity: DM plug-in with shared support yields zero BC on positive bank because sub-strata (C,R) have insufficient samples for conditional entropy to differ from marginal entropy.
Identifiability tension: Frozen R generation requires regime signal in R, but with only 5 latent states, any hash preserving regime signal also preserves latent state signal (MI ≈ 2.3 bits).
No genuine DOM/browser/CP measurements: Purely synthetic banks as mandated by Director for calibration-first approach.
